newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast in second mineral deal with Equigold.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast in second mineral deal with Equigold.

text.p: Ivory Coast has signed its second mineral exploration deal in a week with Equigold-CI, the state's director of mines Sidibe Kalilou told Reuters on Thursday.
He said the firm, a subsidiary of Equigold Limited, had been granted a permit covering 999 square kilometres in an area near Kokumbo, 200 km northwest of the main city Abidjan.
A government statement said the permit was valid for three years for all minerals except hydrocarbons.
Equigold expected to spend at least 650 million CFA on exploration work, it added.
The decision to grant the permit was taken at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday.
Equigold signed a similar deal last week for an area in the nearby Oume district, Kalilou said.
